summary: 30-year-old Fruita man killed in an ATV crash on a switchback of County Road 243 north of New Castle; lost control, was thrown from the vehicle, and the ATV landed on him. He had left camp and was headed home when the crash occurred; his name had not been released at publication.
location: County Road 243, north of New Castle
notes: Date pinned: the KMTS news roundup places the crash on Monday morning of the July 4, 2016 news week (2016-07-04 was a Monday). Sheriff's report via KMTS Glenwood Springs; no SAR team deployment reported in the item.
